prepare:
cat > entrypoint.sh <<'EPOTE'
#!/bin/sh
if [ -f /conf/app.conf ]; then
  CONF=/conf/app.conf; ARGS=-config=/conf/app.conf
else
  CONF=/app/conf/app.conf; ARGS=
fi
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  [ -n "$driverName" ] && sed -i "s|^driverName *=.*|driverName = $driverName|" "$CONF"
  [ -n "$dataSourceName" ] && sed -i "s|^dataSourceName *=.*|dataSourceName = $dataSourceName|" "$CONF"
  [ -n "$dbName" ] && sed -i "s|^dbName *=.*|dbName = $dbName|" "$CONF"
fi
cd /app && exec /app/casdoor $ARGS
EPOTE

# loong64 self-built (wave7) - store-compatible entrypoint (env -> conf/app.conf)
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata)
WORKDIR /app
COPY casdoor /app/casdoor
COPY conf /app/conf
COPY web/build /app/web/build
COPY entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/casdoor /app/entrypoint.sh
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 8000
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh", "/app/entrypoint.sh"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/eclipse-temurin:21-jdk
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY keycloak /opt/keycloak
RUN chmod -R +x /opt/keycloak/bin/*.sh
WORKDIR /opt/keycloak
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh"]
CMD ["start-dev"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2 libapache2-mod-php ca-certificates php8.4-gd php8.4-mysql php8.4-curl php8.4-zip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY site /var/www/html/
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["sh","-c",". /etc/apache2/envvars && exec apache2 -D FOREGROUND"]

# loong64 self-built (wave3)
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata)
WORKDIR /app
COPY prometheus /app/prometheus
COPY prometheus.yml /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
RUN chmod +x /app/prometheus && mkdir -p /prometheus
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 9090
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/prometheus"]
CMD ["--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml", "--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus"]
